manifest.name: channel-connection
manifest.description: One channel account bound to one space (backlog:e5532d1c9146). Read-only publicly: every field is managed, so a connection exists only through the package's register operation and changes only through its audited actions. The secret itself is never stored here — only the reference the deployment's secret resolver understands.

migrations.name: create_channel_connections
migrations.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS channel_connections (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  source_key TEXT UNIQUE,
  space_id TEXT,
  channel TEXT CHECK(channel IN ('whatsapp', 'instagram', 'facebook', 'tiktok', 'sms', 'email', 'voice', 'site-form', 'calendar', 'stripe')),
  account TEXT,
  adapter TEXT,
  adapter_version INTEGER,
  adapter_fingerprint TEXT,
  status TEXT CHECK(status IN ('pending', 'active', 'suspended', 'revoked')),
  status_reason TEXT,
  secret_ref TEXT,
  secret_rotated_at TEXT,
  grant_expires_at TEXT,
  created_by TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS channel_connections_space_id ON channel_connections(space_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS channel_connections_account ON channel_connections(account);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS channel_connections_status ON channel_connections(status);

bootstrap.name: pg_bootstrap_channel_connections
bootstrap.sql:
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "accordo";

CREATE TABLE "accordo"."channel_connections" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  "source_key" TEXT UNIQUE,
  "space_id" TEXT,
  "channel" TEXT CHECK("channel" IN ('whatsapp', 'instagram', 'facebook', 'tiktok', 'sms', 'email', 'voice', 'site-form', 'calendar', 'stripe')),
  "account" TEXT,
  "adapter" TEXT,
  "adapter_version" BIGINT,
  "adapter_fingerprint" TEXT,
  "status" TEXT CHECK("status" IN ('pending', 'active', 'suspended', 'revoked')),
  "status_reason" TEXT,
  "secret_ref" TEXT,
  "secret_rotated_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "grant_expires_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "created_by" TEXT,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX "channel_connections_space_id"
  ON "accordo"."channel_connections"("space_id");

CREATE INDEX "channel_connections_account"
  ON "accordo"."channel_connections"("account");

CREATE INDEX "channel_connections_status"
  ON "accordo"."channel_connections"("status");
